title: Eigenvalue Counts for Low-Degree Random Regular Graphs
exact_target: For uniformly random $d$-regular graphs on $n$ vertices, improve the estimates for the number of adjacency eigenvalues in a specified interval in the low-degree regime $d\lesssim(\log n)^4$. The target is a quantitative eigenvalue-counting estimate in that regime.
